decision.llm_reasoning: The course objectives explicitly mention 'information systems design' and 'design and implement a software solution for an information system'.

evidence.text: Develop skills in information systems design and deployment, collection and processing of practical data, and evaluation of software solutions; practice teamwork, planning, presentation, and specialized project reporting skills.

Formulate the capacity for self-study, independent research, systems thinking, and innovation; enhance personal and team responsibility during the execution of specialized projects, preparing for internships and graduation theses.

Design and implement a software solution for an information system based on practical or hypothetical requirements, using appropriate tools, techniques, and processes in the field of Information Systems.

Evaluate the developed software solution based on technical criteria, performance, and requirement compliance, thereby proposing improvements to enhance the quality and feasibility of the information system.
